Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 124: July 2011
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #124 shipped to subscribers in June 2011 (bearing the cover date of July 2011 for Issue 124). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #124 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine (third-person action hack-and-slash shooter)
Bodycount (first-person arcade shooter)
Madden NFL 12 (sports simulation)
Toy Soldiers: Cold War (Xbox Live Arcade action-strategy tower defense)
Fruit Ninja Kinect (Xbox Live Arcade motion action)
Radiangames Ballistic (Xbox Live Arcade twin-stick shooter)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring E3 2011 recap coverage for Halo 4, Gears of War 3, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, and Forza Motorsport 4, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
